snippet.title: Demon Bluff | Secret Sauce Showcase trailer
snippet.description:
UmiArt and offbrand games have released a new trailer for Demon Bluff, the single-player social deduction game where your cards LIE! Dig into some new gameplay and get ready for the game to launch on PC later this year.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3522600/Demon_Bluff/

Secret Sauce Showcase Steam Event: http://obp.gg/secretsauce2026
